title: acer buergerianum subsp. ningpoense
intro: Acer buergerianum subsp. ningpoense, commonly known as Ningpo paperbark maple, is a subspecies of the deciduous maple tree native to China. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ningpo paperbark maple are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
